description: Reviewed exceptions for ci-tooling/check_dangerous_patterns.py. Every entry needs a written reason. Prefer fixing the pattern or an inline '# sec100: allow' over adding a broad waiver.

entries.reason: Synthetic credentials in test fixtures (fake JWTs, PEM blocks, sk_live_* samples) are test data, not deployable secrets. detect-secrets' own pre-commit hook applies the same tests/ exclusion. New hardcoded secrets in production code under src/ are still blocked.

Test helper in test_admin_migration_session_authority_after_demotion.py compiles and execs a single function definition lifted from the module under test; the source is a literal in the same file, visible at authoring time. This is test scaffolding, not execution of untrusted data. Reviewed 2026-11-21 during the CI-guard enforcement audit.
